apps.name: Profit Tracker
apps.short: Profit Tracker is a simple and free web app that helps you record weekly income and expenses, calculate your net profit or loss, view financial charts, and save personal notes. All records are stored locally in your browser and organized by date and month.

apps.name: StepTuDeen
apps.short: An Islamic digital platform bringing together the Quran, Hadith, prayer times and mosque services.

apps.name: RochTools
apps.short: Free browser-based tools for creators: video downloader, password generator, QR code, word counter, color picker and Base64.

apps.name: The Mill Game
apps.short: The Mill Game is a feature-rich Nine Men's Morris strategy game by StepTuDeen. Play against the computer, challenge a friend offline, or compete online with real-time voice chat, text messaging, emoji reactions, and spectator mode. Install it as a Progressive Web App on supported devices.

apps.name: Block Blast 3D
apps.short: A fast, offline-ready puzzle game with 3D visuals and multiple theme sounds. Install it on your phone or computer and play anywhere, even without internet.
